_note: `at` = how many steps into the road (one loop is 720 steps). Landmarks are always there; secrets only show when `when` matches. Avoid multiples of 50 so they don't land on an event step.

landmarks.name: The Old Bridge
landmarks.text: A mossy stone bridge over a stream that has outlived its own name.

landmarks.name: The Quiet Windmill
landmarks.text: The sails turn without any hurry. Someone has tied a ribbon to every one.

landmarks.name: Cairn Pass
landmarks.text: Thousands of small stones, each one placed by somebody who was also tired.

landmarks.name: The Frozen Falls
landmarks.text: A waterfall caught mid-word. Up close you can hear it thinking.

landmarks.name: The Sun Gate
landmarks.text: A stone arch that frames the horizon exactly, as if the sky had been measured for it.

landmarks.name: The Lighthouse
landmarks.text: White paint, a lamp the color of honey, and a door that is already open.

secrets.name: The Hidden Shrine
secrets.text: Behind a curtain of ferns sits a shrine no bigger than a bread box. Someone left a tiny bell. You ring it once, softly, and the whole forest seems to exhale.

secrets.name: The Moon Pool
secrets.prompt: A pale light pools in the grass...
secrets.text: A round pool, perfectly still, holding the moon like a coin. A single moon lily floats at its edge. You take one petal and leave the rest.

secrets.name: The Echo Hollow
secrets.prompt: The mist parts around a dark opening...
secrets.text: In the mist, a hollow in the rock answers every sound with a gentler version of itself. Someone has left a scrap of an old map wedged in the stone.

secrets.name: The Aurora Hollow
secrets.prompt: The sky above the ridge is shimmering...
secrets.text: You climb a low rise and the sky unrolls in green and violet. It hums, very faintly, in a key you can almost sing.

secrets.name: The Hidden Oasis
secrets.prompt: Green, where there should be none...
secrets.text: Behind a dune: three palms, a spring, and a small clay pot with a cactus already growing in it. You drink. You do not take the oasis, only the pot.

secrets.name: The Tidepool Cave
secrets.prompt: A cave mouth glitters at the waterline...
secrets.text: Rain on the sea sounds different from inside a cave. The pools hold small stars that turn out to be anemones, and one perfect shell sits on a ledge like a gift.
